_description: Official Webflow hosted MCP server for OAuth-authorized site, Workspace, CMS, and Designer workflows
_workway: Webflow project access without switching out of the agent workflow
_setup: 1. Add the `webflow` server config to your Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, or Codex MCP settings.
2. First use opens Webflow OAuth. Select only the sites or Workspaces this agent should access.
3. To let the agent work in the Designer, open the site in Webflow Designer, press `E`, launch `Webflow MCP Bridge App`, and wait for the app to connect.
_claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http webflow https://mcp.webflow.com/mcp
Then run `/mcp` in Claude Code, select Webflow, and complete OAuth.

requires: Node.js 22.3.0 or later when using mcp-remote

_usage: List all my collections and show me their field structures
Audit my site for broken links, missing alt text, and incomplete meta descriptions
Create a responsive hero section with a headline, description, and CTA button
_security: Limit OAuth authorization to the smallest useful set of sites and Workspaces.
Reauthorize when a project should use a different Webflow site scope.
The Webflow MCP Bridge App installs during OAuth authorization and is not listed in the public Webflow App Marketplace.
